paper.title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver
paper.central_claim: 跨用户轨迹驱动自主evolver持续修订/创建共享技能，同环境夜间验证只部署改进，使Qwen3-Max累积跨用户进步且不退化。

provenance.notes: 按已配置sonnet类型执行；环境标示gpt-6.1-sol，无独立运行凭据/会话ID可存，不额外探测。

sections_read: 全文§1–5、Algorithm1、Tables1–8、Fig1–5文本与三套完整prompt附录；manifest无页图；无独立test/specific cost table

evidence.quote: What is missing is a mechanism that turns ordinary interactions into continuous skill evolution and enables skills to improve collectively across users.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者具体cross-user累积gap；并非所有既有skill均静态已获独立证明。

evidence.quote: We also extract lightweight metadata from each session: (i) which skills were referenced, (ii) whether tool errors occurred, and (iii) a coarse quality estimate.
evidence.support_explanation: 轨迹按skill分组+无skill组；共同skill不等于控制所有混杂。

evidence.quote:
Successful sessions define the
invariants
of a skill, the parts that work and must not be altered.
evidence.support_explanation: 正负证据保留有效部分，局部修补。

evidence.quote: Both versions are executed under the same environment using the full toolchain, including multi-step interactions and intermediate feedback.
This validation step induces a monotonic deployment behavior. Since only improvements are accepted, the deployed skill pool does not degrade over time.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者原单调主张；噪声及重复测试下此推断无保证。

evidence.quote: Our setup involves 8 concurrent users, each interacting with the system under WildClawBench tasks based on their individual goals and task requirements.
evidence.support_explanation: 8用户为模拟部署，6轮，Qwen3-Max包办执行/演化/验证；非人类长期部署。

evidence.quote: Results are reported on four representative categories, with additional categories to be included in the future version.
evidence.support_explanation: 基准60任务6域，结果仅4域，类别子集任务/rollout分母未充分说明。

evidence.quote: Day 2–6 reflect the best skill pool carried forward after each nightly validator decision.
evidence.support_explanation: best部署视图；不是6次独立试验。

evidence.quote: Same-pool retest; nightly readout was stronger, confirming current pool as best-so-far
evidence.support_explanation: Search Day4数值提高无新文本；噪声/选择旧best读数不能归因新技能，关键反证。

evidence.quote: Same-pool retest; validator read a higher result, confirming current pool as best-so-far
evidence.support_explanation: Safety Day5增益亦发生same-pool重测；不证明单调能力增长。

evidence.quote: We observe a consistent improvement after a single round of evolution, with an average gain of +42.1%.
evidence.support_explanation: 三自定义选择/修复query，均值30.4→72.5是42.1百分点；不独立留出。

evidence.quote: This validation strategy introduces additional token cost, as candidate skills must be executed in real environments with full tool interaction.
evidence.support_explanation: 承认代价，但全文无token/时延/dollar实测总账或预算匹配。

evidence.quote: mode, the workspace is rebuilt from scratch each round
evidence.support_explanation: fresh模式history不会自动留存；no-fresh模式保存，不能假定始终完整历史。

evidence.quote:
Copy the current
SKILL.md
content verbatim to
history/v<N>.md
evidence.support_explanation: 快照及证据文件、server哈希差异上传提供可审计接口，不是验证其有效。

evidence.quote: reflects not a sequence of independent experiments, but a continuously running system
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认小样本连续过程；无独立重复/误差区间。
